headline: Passengers foil bid to crash Dubai-Tel Aviv flight after co-pilot stabs pilot
summary: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu credits an Israeli plumber and an Indian pilot for averting a major aviation disaster.
details: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was saved from a potential disaster after passengers intervened to stop a co-pilot from crashing the plane.
The incident occurred when the co-pilot reportedly stabbed the pilot, leading to a chaotic situation in the cockpit.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu credited an Israeli plumber on board and an Indian pilot for their bravery in averting the crash.
Netanyahu stated that Israel will investigate the 'root' of the co-pilot's actions and may participate in the probe into the incident.
Passengers described the experience as terrifying, with one witness stating the plane felt like a 'rollercoaster' as it plummeted downward.
The flight was successfully landed, and the co-pilot is now under investigation.

The flight was successfully landed, and the co-pilot is now under investigation.

headline_marked: Pakistan knock out Tigers; [[Bangladesh's gold bid ends]] at Asian Games
headline: Pakistan knock out Tigers; Bangladesh's gold bid ends at Asian Games
summary: A six-wicket defeat in the rain-shortened semi-final sees the Tigers move to the bronze-medal match.
details: Bangladesh's hopes of winning the men's cricket gold at the Asian Games ended with a six-wicket defeat by Pakistan in a rain-shortened semi-final in Nisshin.
Pakistan chased down 112 with nine balls to spare after Bangladesh posted 111/7 from their 13 overs on Thursday.

The Tigers had Pakistan under pressure early on, reducing them to 17/2 after two overs and later 44/3, but an unbeaten 30 off 15 balls by Abdul Samad and 27 not out by Hasan Nawaz steered Pakistan home.
A decisive swing occurred in Mustafizur Rahman's second over, where Samad hit a six and four successive boundaries, taking 23 runs from the over.
Earlier, Towhid Hridoy struck 42 off 25 balls to lead Bangladesh's recovery from a precarious 21/3 position.
Bangladesh had advanced to the semi-finals without playing their quarter-final against Malaysia due to rain, while Pakistan similarly progressed past Hong Kong without a ball being bowled.
The Tigers will now face the loser of the India-Sri Lanka semi-final in the bronze-medal match on Saturday.
